using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using Garnet.cluster;

namespace Garnet.Tests
{
    public class ReplicaSyncSessionTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task SendCheckpointAsync_LogsInformationOnBeginAndCompleteSendingCheckpointMetadata()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var clusterProviderMock = new Mock<ClusterProvider>();
            var storeWrapperMock = new Mock<StoreWrapper>();

            // Setup minimal required properties and methods for the test
            var replicaCheckpointEntry = new CheckpointEntry
            {
                metadata = new Metadata
                {
                    storeVersion = 1,
                    objectStoreVersion = 1,
                    storePrimaryReplId = "primaryId",
                    objectStorePrimaryReplId = "objectPrimaryId",
                    storeHlogToken = Guid.NewGuid(),
                    objectStoreHlogToken = Guid.NewGuid()
                }
            };

            // We create a ReplicaSyncSession instance with the logger mock and minimal dependencies
            var session = new ReplicaSyncSession(
                storeWrapperMock.Object,
                clusterProviderMock.Object,
                replicaCheckpointEntry: replicaCheckpointEntry,
                replicaNodeId: "replicaNodeId",
                logger: loggerMock.Object);

            // Act
            // We call SendCheckpointAsync but it will likely throw or fail due to missing dependencies,
            // so we catch exceptions to allow the test to continue.
            try
            {
                await session.SendCheckpointAsync();
            }
            catch
            {
                // ignored
            }

            // Assert
            // Verify that LogInformation was called with the expected message containing "<Complete sending checkpoint metadata"
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Information,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("<Complete sending checkpoint metadata")),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.AtLeastOnce);
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using Garnet.cluster;
using Garnet.client;
using Garnet.common;
using Garnet.server;
using System.Net;
using System.Threading;

namespace Garnet.Tests
{
    public class ReplicaSyncSessionTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task SendCheckpointAsync_LogsCompleteSendingCheckpointMetadata()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var clusterProviderMock = new Mock<ClusterProvider>();
            var storeWrapperMock = new Mock<StoreWrapper>();

            // Setup minimal required properties and methods for the test
            var replicaCheckpointEntry = new CheckpointEntry(
                new Metadata(
                    storeVersion: 1,
                    objectStoreVersion: 1,
                    storePrimaryReplId: "primaryId",
                    objectStorePrimaryReplId: "objectPrimaryId",
                    storeHlogToken: Guid.NewGuid(),
                    objectStoreHlogToken: Guid.NewGuid(),
                    storeIndexToken: Guid.NewGuid(),
                    objectStoreIndexToken: Guid.NewGuid()
                )
            );

            // Setup clusterManager and CurrentConfig to return a valid address and port
            var clusterManagerMock = new Mock<IClusterManager>();
            var currentConfigMock = new Mock<IClusterConfig>();
            currentConfigMock.Setup(c => c.GetWorkerAddressFromNodeId(It.IsAny<string>())).Returns(("127.0.0.1", 12345));
            clusterManagerMock.SetupGet(c => c.CurrentConfig).Returns(currentConfigMock.Object);
            clusterProviderMock.SetupGet(c => c.clusterManager).Returns(clusterManagerMock.Object);

            // Setup replicationManager to provide dummy methods
            var replicationManagerMock = new Mock<IReplicationManager>();
            clusterProviderMock.SetupGet(c => c.replicationManager).Returns(replicationManagerMock.Object);

            // Setup serverOptions with ReplicaSyncTimeout
            var serverOptionsMock = new Mock<IServerOptions>();
            serverOptionsMock.SetupGet(o => o.ReplicaSyncTimeout).Returns(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1));
            clusterProviderMock.SetupGet(c => c.serverOptions).Returns(serverOptionsMock.Object);

            // Setup GetReplicationLogCheckpointManager to return dummy objects
            clusterProviderMock.Setup(c => c.GetReplicationLogCheckpointManager(It.IsAny<StoreType>())).Returns(new object());

            // Setup AcquireCheckpointEntryAsync to return a valid CheckpointEntry and null AofSyncTaskInfo
            var session = new TestReplicaSyncSession(
                storeWrapperMock.Object,
                clusterProviderMock.Object,
                replicaCheckpointEntry,
                CancellationToken.None,
                "replicaNodeId",
                null,
                replicaCheckpointEntry,
                0,
                0,
                loggerMock.Object);

            // Act
            try
            {
                await session.SendCheckpointAsync();
            }
            catch
            {
                // Ignored - we expect exceptions due to incomplete mocks
            }

            // Assert
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Information,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("<Complete sending checkpoint metadata")),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.AtLeastOnce);
        }

        // A derived class to override AcquireCheckpointEntryAsync for testability
        private class TestReplicaSyncSession : ReplicaSyncSession
        {
            public TestReplicaSyncSession(
                StoreWrapper storeWrapper,
                ClusterProvider clusterProvider,
                CheckpointEntry replicaCheckpointEntry,
                CancellationToken token,
                string replicaNodeId,
                string replicaAssignedPrimaryId,
                CheckpointEntry replicaCheckpointEntry2,
                long replicaAofBeginAddress,
                long replicaAofTailAddress,
                ILogger logger)
                : base(storeWrapper, clusterProvider, null, token, replicaNodeId, replicaAssignedPrimaryId, replicaCheckpointEntry2, replicaAofBeginAddress, replicaAofTailAddress, logger)
            {
            }

            protected override Task<(CheckpointEntry, AofSyncTaskInfo)> AcquireCheckpointEntryAsync()
            {
                // Return the replicaCheckpointEntry and null AofSyncTaskInfo immediately
                return Task.FromResult((this.replicaCheckpointEntry, (AofSyncTaskInfo)null));
            }
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Reflection;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Garnet.Tests
{
    public class ReplicaSyncSessionLoggingTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task SendCheckpointAsync_LogsCompleteSendingCheckpointMetadata()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();

            // Use reflection to get the internal ReplicaSyncSession type
            var assembly = typeof(Garnet.cluster.ReplicaSyncSession).Assembly;
            var replicaSyncSessionType = assembly.GetType("Garnet.cluster.ReplicaSyncSession");
            Assert.NotNull(replicaSyncSessionType);

            // Prepare constructor parameters with nulls or mocks as needed
            var ctor = replicaSyncSessionType.GetConstructors(BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Public)[0];
            var parameters = ctor.GetParameters();

            object[] args = new object[parameters.Length];
            for (int i = 0; i < parameters.Length; i++)
            {
                var paramType = parameters[i].ParameterType;
                if (paramType == typeof(ILogger))
                    args[i] = loggerMock.Object;
                else if (paramType == typeof(string))
                    args[i] = "replicaNodeId";
                else if (paramType.IsValueType)
                    args[i] = Activator.CreateInstance(paramType);
                else
                    args[i] = null;
            }

            // Create instance
            var instance = ctor.Invoke(args);

            // Get SendCheckpointAsync method
            var method = replicaSyncSessionType.GetMethod("SendCheckpointAsync", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.NonPublic);
            Assert.NotNull(method);

            // Act
            try
            {
                var task = (Task<bool>)method.Invoke(instance, null);
                await task;
            }
            catch
            {
                // Ignored - incomplete mocks may cause exceptions
            }

            // Assert
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Information,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("<Complete sending checkpoint metadata")),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.AtLeastOnce);
        }
    }
}
